facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2025-0236 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 28 November 2025 as a scheduled change under change assurance; no event precedes it in the record. The change assurance record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to relax a material unwanted event control requirement, and the basis for the relaxation is recorded with the change. The record reached the state closed in the change stream.
response.risk_note: This change relaxes a control: 0 steps of relaxation are recorded against it, and the residual risk position rests on that relaxation having been accepted deliberately.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are MOC-2019-0221, PRO-MEC-021, PTW-STD-002, STD-ISO-006 and STD-PTW-001.
